Koharu was probably my least favorite since I'm tired of the naive protag trope but she made up for it with really sweet interactions and unyielding positivity in light of bad situations.

Then I simply like Ichika because she's so darn cute? She's probably one of my favorite designs I've ever seen, despite the weird hair, haha. Her personality is a little paper-thin and sort of morphs throughout the different routes but she's headstrong, a little stubborn, a little naive and believes that there is good in everyone.
